<module id="multi_booth_8bit">
    <description>8-bit Radix-4 Booth multiplier using the Booth algorithm.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="reset">Reset signal used to initialize the multiplier module.</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input representing the multiplicand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input representing the multiplier.</input>
        <output id="p" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output representing the product of the multiplication.</output>
        <output id="rdy">Ready signal indicating the completion of the multiplication operation.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>RESET</parameter>
        <parameter>LOAD</parameter>
        <parameter>MULTIPLY</parameter>
        <parameter>READY</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="multiplier" width="16">Multiplier register.</reg>
        <reg id="multiplicand" width="16">Multiplicand register.</reg>
        <reg id="product" width="16">Product register.</reg>
        <reg id="ctr" width="5">Counter register.</reg>
        <wire id="ready_flag">Ready flag.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
            if (reset) begin
                multiplier <= {8{a[7]}, a};
                multiplicand <= {8{b[7]}, b};
                product <= 16'b0;
                ctr <= 5'b0;
                ready_flag <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case (ctr)
                    5'b0: begin
                        // Load initial values
                        multiplier <= {8{a[7]}, a};
                        multiplicand <= {8{b[7]}, b};
                        product <= 16'b0;
                        ctr <= 5'b1;
                    end
                    5'b16: begin
                        // Multiplication complete
                        ready_flag <= 1'b1;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        // Booth algorithm steps
                        if (multiplier[ctr] == 1'b1) begin
                            product <= product + multiplicand;
                        end
                        multiplicand <= {multiplicand[14:0], 1'b0}; // Left shift multiplicand
                        ctr <= ctr + 1'b1;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        assign rdy = ready_flag;
    </implementation>
</module>
